description: Seismische Stationen - Beeinflussungsbereich Windenergieanlagen (WFS Dienst) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by nibis.lbeg.de. When planning wind turbines, the operation of seismic stations must be taken into account. The provider reports that ground disturbance transmitted through wind turbine foundations during operation impairs the signal quality of seismic measuring stations. The interfering signals superimpose seismic signals and adversely affect the observation conditions of earthquake monitoring. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Seismic Stations - Area of Influence Wind Turbines (WFS Service)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OGC::WFS, infoFeatureAccessService, inspireidentifiziert, NIBIS-Metadaten, opendata, sgd_Erdbeben. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
